## **Qwen-Image-2.1-Natural-Exposure-LoRA**

Qwen-Image-2.1-Natural-Exposure-LoRA is a LoRA adapter for [Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1), designed to transform images with balanced, neutral exposure while preserving natural colors, details, lighting, and overall image consistency.

> [!NOTE]
> This is an experimental preview model. Results may vary depending on the input image, lighting conditions, and overall image composition.

## Model Details

* **Base Model:** [Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1)
* **Adapter:** `Qwen-Image-2.1-Natural-Exposure-LoRA`
* **Model Type:** LoRA / Adapter
* **Model Status:** Preview / Experimental
* **Created by:** [prithivMLmods](https://huggingface.co/prithivMLmods)
